title: Venture's Adventures | Trapnest Studio
description: From the Trapnest Studio visual archive. Original work by THE LINE and the artists credited in this collection. A trailer made for Overwatch 2, marking the addition of the 40th Hero character - Venture.

children: Visual archive / Original work and editorial by
Our second collaboration with Overwatch2 for a trailer introducing the game's 40th Hero character - Venture!

In this film, we wanted to highlight what makes Venture unique. Venture is an adventurer, dedicated to fiercely protecting historical artefacts (often finding a way to involve their signature drilling in doing so). But we were committed to also highlighting their youthful charm, showcasing the human behind the drill... We wanted Venture's debut to be as impactful as possible so we kept things simple to allow for the optimal blend of clarity and quality. Drawing inspiration from TV shows like SamuraiJack, famous for their spectacular but simple style, allowed us to make space for the narrative, leaving the rest relatively abstract.

children: In this lovely trailer for Overwatch 2's hero Venture, I aimed to capture what truly makes Venture special. While showcasing their intense passion for discovering and safeguarding historical artifacts was important, my primary focus was on presenting Venture as the charismatic and intriguing young adventurer they are—the human behind the drill. To achieve this, I chose to frame the story around a treasure quest, which not only allows us to embark on an archaeological journey through the Overwatch universe but also offers a deeper exploration of Venture’s personality. We see them in all facets—from the quiet, cozy moments spent researching in their room to the thrill of exploring ancient ruins, engaging with locals, taking down thieves, and, of course, doing what they love most: drilling.
